title: Public ARB daily-publication receipt
description: Frozen public projection of archive/YYYY/MM/DD/PUBLICATION.json. It contains publication facts only; operational, repository, run and operator metadata are forbidden.

publication_date.description: The edition's America/Mexico_City calendar date. The bridge also requires it to equal the date encoded by the receipt path.

published_at.description: Actual publication time with an RFC 3339 offset. Its America/Mexico_City date must equal publication_date.

edition_id.description: Stable opaque public identity for this edition; never a private commit, run or operator identity.

story_ids.description: Public story identifiers included by this daily publication decision.

status.description: PUBLISHED means an edition was issued; QUIET is an authoritative no-material-change publication decision.
